facts.business: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Limited is a banking company providing financial services including deposits, advances, and treasury operations.
facts.related_party_note: The policy on dealing with related party transactions is available on the Bank's website https://www.tmb.bank.in/pages/Regulatory-Policies. There were no materially significant transactions entered into by the Bank with its directors, management or their relatives conflicting with the interest of the Bank at large during the year ended March 31, 2026.
